main_body: Three small kegs stacked in a pyramid (one on top, two below), each drawn as a front-facing barrel with red hoops, a brown body and a dark brown outline
top_band: none: the column starts with a 1-row dark brown outline (rows ~2-3), then goes straight into an orange/red hoop band and the stave face. There is no lighter ellipse cap.
evidence: Reading a column through the top keg: dark outline at the top, then hoop bands and staves with no horizontal lid surface. The top is only a 1-row rim, which the guide marks as RIM ONLY or lid 2px. The kegs read as flat front views with banding, not as cylinders seen from above, and the lower kegs are the same. No ellipse top is visible on any of them.

style.evidence: The kegs use about 4 tones (orange highlight, red, brown, dark brown). The dark brown outline is tinted, so it is not near-black. The red hoops and brown staves are small flat blocks with almost no grain, speckle or per-stave highlights. Next to the stall and well references, each tile carries only about 3-5 colours, so it looks thinner and flatter.
